answer: To deter Sybil attacks, the network imposes superlinear stake burning tied to agent density. Each clone must burn token deposits scaling quadratically: burning cost C(k) = s * k^2 for k identities. If an adversary attempts to register a meadow of fake nodes, economic friction makes total outlay explode superlinearly. Even if nodes whisper hidden coordinates to coordinate, the cryptographic burn drains their capital against a rigid karst topography of identity stakes.
